rationale: The SDC binds src_data to src_clk as an asynchronous source, and a full two-stage synchroniser contains it. The contract calls it a free-running level and states no requirement to deliver every transition or to hold a minimum duration, so sampled-level aliasing is acceptable.
caveats: CST-011(b) does not apply because src_data is named by set_input_delay. CDC-013(a) is register-launched, (b) needs an output delay and (c) needs boundary_events, so no CDC-013 finding is expected despite the contract's 'may remain'. Expect only CDC-029 INFO.
This is a boundary-intent control with weak semantics. If the maintainer reads 'free-running' as an implied delivery need, regrade it to unknown.

No whole-IP clean premise. Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
